criterion1.claim: Desktop mouse and Enter rapid reset at 180 ms remain empty after 1.5 seconds.
criterion1.gap: Acceptance explicitly requires mouse, touch, and Enter. Batch 37 contains no touch run and no raw interaction/timeline artifact; the prose claim alone is not independently auditable.

criterion2.gap: No new evidence for reset-then-reselect or cancellation ordering beyond the previously accepted script sequence.

criterion3.gap: No complete desktop/mobile regression for all three stable variants plus quantity/min=1 on variable and simple products in this batch.

criterion4.claim: Staging clicks on Add to cart and Buy now with empty variation_id produced zero requests.
criterion4.gap: No staging URL/build identifier, HAR/network export, trace, screenshot, or raw session artifact was committed. A disabled-button no-request observation alone also does not establish server-side rejection if a malformed request bypasses UI state.

requiredToClose: Touch rapid-reset evidence at 150–250 ms with final state after at least one second.
Reset-then-reselect and rapid multi-selection evidence showing only the final choice renders.
Desktop/mobile three-variant and quantity/min=1 regression evidence.

Auditable staging trace for every purchase CTA with empty variation_id, including request interception/HAR and the tested build/URL; include server response to a safely isolated malformed request if claiming backend protection.
